messages.subject: Re: Air freight quote request: FRA to LOS
messages.body:
Dear Anna Sonnberg,

For your spare parts, the quickest option from FRA to LOS is Tamarind Airways: 3 days in transit, 6158.54 EUR all-in. That covers air freight, fuel and security surcharges. Because of the volume, the freight is calculated on 1,377.75 kg chargeable weight.

With the cargo ready on Monday 23 November, the earliest arrival in Lagos would be Thursday 26 November. That is with a departure from FRA on Monday 23 November.

The rate is good until 21:49 today. Let me know if you would like to go ahead and I'll book it straight away.

Kind regards,
Lena Berger
Air Export, PIXEL Air Freight
